title: Somebody Loves You, Mr. Hatch
author: Eileen Spinelli
intro: Mr. Hatch lives by himself. Every day he walks to work at a shoelace factory.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide

questions.clue: They make the laces that tie your shoes.
questions.yes: Mr. Hatch works at a shoelace factory.

questions.q: What does Mr. Hatch eat for lunch every day?

options.text: A bowl of tomato soup and bread

questions.yes: Mr. Hatch eats a cheese and mustard sandwich every day.

questions.q: What is Mr. Hatch like at the start?

options.text: He chats to everyone he meets

questions.clue: He does not chat with his neighbours.
questions.yes: At the start, Mr. Hatch kept to himself.

questions.q: Who brings Mr. Hatch a big package?

options.text: A pair of sparkly new running shoes

questions.clue: It is shaped like a heart.
questions.yes: Inside was a big heart-shaped box of chocolates.

questions.q: What does the little card say?
questions.clue: It is the name of the story.
It is a day for hearts and love.

questions.q: How does Mr. Hatch feel after reading the card?
questions.clue: He thinks somebody cares about him.
questions.yes: Mr. Hatch felt happy that somebody loved him.

questions.q: Whose newsstand does Mr. Hatch look after?
questions.yes: Mr. Hatch looked after Mr. Smith's newsstand.

questions.q: Why does Mr. Smith need someone to watch his newsstand?

options.text: He has to see the doctor
He has lost his shop keys

questions.clue: He was not feeling very well.
questions.yes: Mr. Smith felt ill and had to go to the doctor.

questions.q: Who does Mr. Hatch help to find?

options.text: A lost puppy in the park

questions.clue: Her dad was very worried about her.
questions.yes: Mr. Hatch found a worried father's little girl.

questions.q: What does the postman tell Mr. Hatch?

options.text: The box went to the wrong house
He has won a big prize

questions.clue: The box was meant for somebody else.
questions.yes: The postman said the box was delivered by mistake.

questions.q: How does Mr. Hatch feel when he gives the box back?
questions.clue: He thinks nobody loves him after all.
questions.yes: Mr. Hatch felt sad. He thought nobody loved him.

questions.q: What do the neighbours do for Mr. Hatch?
questions.clue: There is food, a present and a big sign.
questions.yes: The neighbours threw Mr. Hatch a big surprise party.

questions.q: What does the big sign at the party say?
questions.clue: It is like the card, but it says "Everybody".
questions.yes: The sign said, "Everybody loves Mr. Hatch."
